distribution: target warehouse: two permitted owners at suffixes 0/1 modulo 1000; other warehouse: permitted owners on every row

plan.sql: WITH document_page AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT candidates.id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unnest($3::text[])::uuid AS owner_id) AS permitted_owner CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id FROM contracts_v1.documents WHERE organization_id=$1::text::uuid AND warehouse_id=$2::text::uuid AND owner_id>=permitted_owner.owner_id AND owner_id<=permitted_owner.owner_id ORDER BY owner_id,id LIMIT $4) AS candidates ORDER BY candidates.id LIMIT $4) SELECT to_jsonb(document_details) FROM document_page JOIN contracts_v1.document_details USING (id) ORDER BY document_details.id
